items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: I played the Ripper band. Most of the Tuxedo band. Now which Tuxedo is that? Papa Saris Band. The original.

ctx.x: I played the Ripper band. Most of the Tuxedo band. Now which Tuxedo is that? Papa Saris Band. The original.
Yeah. And I also played in the Tulane brass band that L.C. Landry was later. He's dead now.
